subject: general
question: Which of the following Sections of the Indian Penal Code deals with 'rape'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Section 375**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Section 375** of the Indian Penal Code defines the offense of rape.
 
• This section outlines the different circumstances under which a sexual act is considered rape, including lack of consent, consent obtained through force or fraud, and situations involving minors.
 
• It specifies the punishment for rape, which can vary depending on the severity of the crime.
 
• The section has been amended several times to address changing societal norms and to strengthen the legal framework for protecting victims of sexual violence.
 
• Section 375 is a crucial part of India's legal system aimed at safeguarding the dignity and bodily autonomy of individuals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Indian Penal Code (IPC)** was enacted in 1860 and is the principal criminal code of India.
 
• It covers all substantive aspects of criminal law and has been amended numerous times to keep pace with the changing needs of society.
 
• Other important sections related to sexual offenses include **Section 376** (punishment for rape) and **Section 354** (assault or criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty).
 
• The Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013, also known as the Nirbhaya Act, brought significant changes to the IPC, including stricter punishments for sexual offenses.
 
• The IPC is complemented by other laws such as the Protection of Children from Sexual Offenses (POCSO) Act, which specifically addresses sexual crimes against minors.
